successCriteria.description: `LeaveType` enum is defined in `src/shared/types/index.ts` with exactly three members: ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY
`LeaveRequestStatus` enum is defined in `src/shared/types/index.ts` with exactly five members: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED
`EmploymentStatus` type alias is defined in `src/shared/types/index.ts` as the string literal union `'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | 'TERMINATED'`

`AppError` abstract base class is defined in `src/shared/errors/index.ts` with `statusCode: number`, `code: string`, and optional `details` field, accepting `message`, `statusCode`, `code`, and optional `details` in its constructor
`NotFoundError` extends `AppError` with statusCode 404 and a distinguishing code string
`ValidationError` extends `AppError` with statusCode 400 and a distinguishing code string
`ConflictError` extends `AppError` with statusCode 409 and a distinguishing code string

`IBaseRepository<T>` generic interface is defined in `src/shared/base.repository.ts` with methods: `findById(id: string): Promise<T | null>`, `findAll(filter?: Partial<T>): Promise<T[]>`, `create(entity: Partial<T>): Promise<T>`, `update(id: string, entity: Partial<T>): Promise<T>`, `delete(id: string): Promise<void>`

`tests/unit/shared/types.spec.ts` contains Jest tests that verify all enum members exist with correct values for both `LeaveType` and `LeaveRequestStatus`, and that `EmploymentStatus` union type accepts only valid literal strings

`tests/unit/shared/errors.spec.ts` contains Jest tests verifying each error class (`NotFoundError`, `ValidationError`, `ConflictError`) instantiates correctly with the expected `statusCode`, `code`, `message`, and optional `details`

constraints: All TypeScript code must use strict mode — no implicit `any`, strict null checks (per HARNESS.json stack description)
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards instead (per HARNESS.json constraint rule `no-any`)
All database access must go through the repository pattern (GP-001), but this phase creates only the interface contract — no database calls are made
Tests use Jest as the test framework (per HARNESS.json stack)
No hardcoded secrets, passwords, API keys, or tokens (per HARNESS.json constraint rule `no-hardcoded-secrets`)
outOfScope: Repository implementations — only the `IBaseRepository<T>` interface contract is created; concrete repository classes (EmployeeRepository, LeavePolicyRepository, LeaveRepository, LeaveBalanceRepository) are in Phases 2, 3, 4, and 8
Domain models (Employee, LeavePolicy, LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance interfaces) — these are created in Phases 2, 3, 4, and 8
Business logic services (LeaveService, BalanceService) — these are in Phases 5 and 9
Fastify routes, controllers, and API endpoints — these are in Phases 6 and 7
Database migrations (Knex schema) — these are in Phase 10
RBAC enforcement, audit logging, and input validation at API boundaries — these are handled in later phases when routes and services are built

ambiguities.description: The `code` string values for each error subclass are not explicitly specified (e.g., `"NOT_FOUND"` vs `"RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND"` for `NotFoundError`). The implementer must choose consistent code strings.
The type of the optional `details` field on `AppError` is not specified. It could be `unknown`, `Record<string, unknown>`, or a more specific type.
